registry.deviceZone: Compass uses this phone's time zone, {zone}, until you choose one.
registry.deviceLanguage: Compass follows this phone's language until you or your organization choose one.
registry.date: Enter the date as year-month-day, for example 2026-11-02.
registry.dateHelp: Year-month-day, for example 2026-11-02. Leave it blank for no date.

zones.searchHelp: Type a city or region, for example Chicago.
zones.none: No time zone matches. Check the spelling, or type the full name, for example America/Chicago.

notifications.orgsHelp: Each organization you belong to keeps its own choices. Atlas shows the same ones.
notifications.timeHelp: 24-hour time, for example 22:00. Leave both times blank for no quiet hours.
notifications.otherHelp: Organizations you work with without being a member, and marketplace alerts. In-app notifications always show in your Inbox. Gateway shows the same choices.
notifications.ownQuietHelp: Push notifications from organizations you are not a member of wait until your quiet hours end. Safety alerts, changes to your sign-in security, a recovery code used on your account and a new or changed shift starting within 12 hours still reach you. Email is never held.

errors.time: Enter the time as hours and minutes, for example 22:00.
errors.pair: Set both a start and an end, or leave both blank to turn quiet hours off.
errors.same: Choose an end time different from the start.
errors.zone: Choose your time zone from the list.

outOfOffice.order: End on or after the start date.

workDetails.offline: Work details are edited online only, so they never stay on this phone.
workDetails.webHelp: Your passport, loyalty programs, what you share with each engagement and your access log open in Gateway.
